Description:
  MCP server exposing agent memory over sqlite-memory

Usage:
  AiRaccoon [command] [options]

Options:
  --transport <stdio|http|https|proxy>  MCP transport; proxy (default) relays to one HTTP backend, https unsupported
  --data-root <path>                    Bank data root (must precede the verb)
  --install-scope <user|project>        Install scope (must precede the verb)
  --quiet                               Quiet mode: every log level goes to a file beside the bank, nothing reaches stdout/stderr
  --port <port>                         HTTP backend port the proxy dials or starts (1-65535); 0 is serve-only [default: 7721]
  -?, -h, --help                        Show help and usage information
  --version                             Show version information

Commands:
  settings    Runtime configuration, one node per subsystem. Operations live at the top level: 'watch registered', 'extract prune', 'noise entries', 'model set', 'encryption', 'serve'.
  model       Embedding engine selection — 'model set' starts a re-embed of the bank in the background; its configuration is shown and reset under 'settings model'
  watch       Registered watches. Watching is CONFIGURED under 'settings watch'; registrations are created by agents via the memory_watch_add MCP tool.
  extract     Shared-extraction operations. The service is CONFIGURED under 'settings extract'.
  noise       Rejected-write training data. Rejection is CONFIGURED under 'settings noise'.
  encryption  Bank encryption source configuration
  serve       Serves the MCP endpoint over HTTP (always HTTP). Background it: ai-raccoon serve > serve.log 2>&1 &

Description:
  Background shared-extraction configuration: enables or disables the hosted service that periodically checks each project's committed memories and extracts the shared-worthy ones, and sets its mode (propose logs candidates; promote shares them).

Usage:
  AiRaccoon settings extract [command] [options]

Options:
  -?, -h, --help  Show help and usage information

Commands:
  enable <true|false>     Enables or disables the background shared-extraction service (disabled by default; promote mode shares data between projects)
  mode <propose|promote>  Sets the extraction mode: propose (default, logs ranked candidates) or promote (shares the top candidates into the shared tier)
  interval <minutes>      Sets the extraction pass interval in minutes (positive integer; default 30)
  capacity <capacity>     Sets the propose-tier queue capacity (positive integer; default 1000) — the total queued candidates across projects, split into per-project reservations
  exclude                 Excludes source_file prefixes from shared-extraction candidacy (extract.exclude.prefixes; e.g. 'scratch/' keeps agent scratch files out of the shared tier)
  list, show              Shows the extraction configuration (enabled, mode, interval minutes)

Description:
  Metrics subsystem configuration (CLI-only channel): buffer capacity and flush interval tune the background writer, hot-table retention tunes the reaper. Each takes effect on a different cadence — buffer capacity on the next server restart, flush interval on the next flush tick, retention on the next maintenance pass — every command below states its own.

Usage:
  AiRaccoon settings performance [command] [options]

Options:
  -?, -h, --help  Show help and usage information

Commands:
  buffer-capacity <capacity>  Sets the measurement buffer capacity (positive integer, max 1000000; default 1000) — takes effect on the next server restart
  flush-interval <seconds>    Sets the metrics flush interval in seconds (positive integer; default 30) — takes effect on the next flush tick
  retention <days>            Sets the hot metrics-table retention in days (positive integer, max 36500; default 28) — takes effect on the next maintenance pass
  list, show                  Shows the metrics subsystem configuration (buffer capacity, flush interval, retention)

Description:
  S3-compatible endpoint (credentials are persisted in the settings table, or use --cli for the AWS credential chain)

Usage:
  AiRaccoon settings sync add s3 <url> [options]

Arguments:
  <url>

Options:
  --bucket <name> (REQUIRED)  S3 bucket name
  --region <name>             S3 region
  --object-key <key>          S3 object key (default memory-<projectId>.db)
  --cli                       Use the AWS default credential chain (aws configure / aws sso login); no key prompts
  -?, -h, --help              Show help and usage information
